insight.headline: Order Tax Recalculation
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated for unfulfilled orders. This change ensures accurate tax calculations based on the new shipping destination. The update applies to the GraphQL Admin API version 2026-10 and later.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their order update logic to account for the new tax recalculation behavior. This change may affect existing order management workflows, especially those that involve shipping address changes. Developers should review their code and test their implementations to ensure compatibility with the updated API behavior. The orderUpdate mutation now returns the updated tax information, which can be used to update the order totals and ensure accurate billing.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see more accurate tax calculations for orders with updated shipping addresses, reducing potential errors and discrepancies. This change improves the overall order management experience and ensures compliance with tax regulations.
insight.why_it_matters: Accurate tax calculations are crucial for merchants to avoid revenue losses and ensure compliance with tax laws. This update helps merchants maintain accurate financial records and provides a better customer experience by ensuring correct billing and invoicing.

also_worth_knowing.text: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes

updates.title: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
updates.summary: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query performance data on behalf of authorized merchants. The shop_campaign_insights schema is now available in ShopifyQL.
CLI version 4.6.1 now serves UI extension source maps during app development. This change improves the development experience for UI extensions.

updates.title: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, allowing for more flexibility in cart management. The updateCart standard action now updates cart attributes.

updates.title: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed
updates.summary: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed, changing how in-progress inventory holds are represented. This change may require updates to inventory management logic.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, allowing AI agents to interact with online stores. Agents can search catalogs, manage carts, and go to checkout on behalf of shoppers.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing developers to deploy Hydrogen storefronts to Oxygen from dev stores. Note that development stores don't include public environments.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, allowing for more flexibility in order management. A trackingNumbers field has been added to OrderCreateFulfillmentInput.

updates.title: Updated Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps
updates.summary: Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have been updated, with new thresholds that better reflect fulfillment operations. These changes make Built for Shopify more achievable for apps.

updates.title: Hydrogen developer preview update: July 30, 2026
updates.summary: The Hydrogen developer preview has been updated with new capabilities, including Vue bindings. Developers can now build storefronts in Vue with the same Hydrogen API.

updates.title: New fields for cash management activities and drawers in POS
updates.summary: New fields are available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities. These fields include Cash Drawer balance and cash count activities.
CLI version 4.6.0 has removed deprecated draftable extension process and dev session support branching. Flags have been added to avoid prompts in app config linking.

updates.title: Merchants now see partner details on collaborator requests
updates.summary: Merchants now see partner details on collaborator requests, providing more context for decision-making. This change improves trust and confidence in collaborator access.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance performance data, storefront events, and inventory management

themes.title: Performance Data and Analytics
themes.detail: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, enabling analytics and reporting apps to query data on behalf of authorized merchants. This update enhances the capabilities of apps using the GraphQL Admin API.

themes.title: Storefront and Inventory Management
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, and draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is being consolidated from reserved to committed. WebMCP support has also been added for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, allowing AI agents to interact with online stores.
